questions.q: How do you say 'We celebrate my grandmother's birthday'?
options: Celebramos la Navidad de mi abuela
Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi abuela
Celebro el cumpleaños de mi abuela
Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi abuelo
questions.explain: 'Celebramos' = 'we celebrate' and 'de mi abuela' = 'my grandmother's', so the first option is correct.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I'm a fan of pop music”?
options: Estoy aficionado a la música pop
Soy aficionado a la música pop
Soy aficionada a la música clásica
questions.explain: “Ser aficionado a” = “to be a fan of”, so “Soy aficionado a la música pop”.

questions.q: What does “el villancico” mean?
questions.explain: “El villancico” means “a Christmas carol”.

questions.q: How do you say “At weekends I go out with my friends”?
options: Los fines de semana salgo con mi familia
Los fines de semana salgo con mis amigos
Los fines de semana sale con mis amigos
Los fines de semana salí con mis amigos
questions.explain: “Salgo con mis amigos” = “I go out with my friends”, in the present for a routine.

questions.q: What does “El Día de la Hispanidad” celebrate?
questions.explain: “El Día de la Hispanidad” (12 October) celebrates Hispanic heritage and the Spanish-speaking world.

questions.q: How do you say “I like reading novels”?
questions.explain: “Leer novelas” = to read novels, so “Me gusta leer novelas”.

questions.q: What does “el correo electrónico” mean?
questions.explain: “El correo electrónico” means “email”.

questions.q: What does “la Semana Santa” mean?
questions.explain: “La Semana Santa” literally “Holy Week” is the Easter celebration with processions.

questions.q: How do you say 'My favourite singer is very famous'?
options: Mi cantante favorita es muy famoso
Mi cantante favorito está muy famoso
Mi cantante favorito es muy hambriento
Mi cantante favorito es muy famoso
questions.explain: 'Es' is used for permanent fame, and 'favorito/famoso' agree as masculine: 'Mi cantante favorito es muy famoso'.

questions.q: What does 'la Nochebuena' mean?
questions.explain: 'La Nochebuena' (24 December) means 'Christmas Eve'; 'la Nochevieja' is New Year's Eve.

questions.q: What does “quedarse en casa” mean?
questions.explain: “Quedarse” = to stay, so “quedarse en casa” = “to stay at home”.

questions.q: What does “una entrada” mean (for a concert)?
questions.explain: “Una entrada” means a “ticket” for an event (it can also mean a starter or doorway).

questions.q: How do you say “It is a tradition that lasts three days”?
options: Es una tradición que dura tres años
Es una tradición que duran tres días
Era una tradición que dura tres días
Es una tradición que dura tres días
questions.explain: “Durar” = to last, so “que dura tres días” = “that lasts three days”.

questions.q: What does “las noticias” mean?
questions.explain: “Las noticias” means “the news”; “nuevo/a” would be “new”.

questions.q: How do you say “I spend too much time online”?
questions.explain: “Paso demasiado tiempo en línea” = “I spend too much time online”.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I'm keen on cooking”?
questions.explain: “Me apasiona” + infinitive = “I'm passionate/keen on”; “cocinar” = to cook (not “coser” = to sew).

questions.q: What does “montar a caballo” mean?
questions.explain: “Montar a caballo” means “to go horse riding”.

questions.q: What does “los seguidores” mean on social media?
questions.explain: “Los seguidores” means “followers”, from “seguir” (to follow).

questions.q: What does 'el correo electrónico' mean?
questions.explain: 'El correo electrónico' literally 'electronic mail' means 'email'.

questions.q: What does “las uvas de la suerte” refer to at New Year?
options: The lucky grapes eaten at midnight
questions.explain: In Spain people eat twelve “uvas de la suerte” (lucky grapes), one on each chime of midnight.

questions.q: What does 'descargar música' mean?
questions.explain: 'Descargar' means 'to download', so 'descargar música' = 'to download music'.

questions.q: Which sentence means “The whole family gets together to have dinner”?
options: Toda la familia se reúne para desayunar
Toda la familia se reúne para comer
Todo la familia se reúne para cenar
Toda la familia se reúne para cenar
questions.explain: “Reunirse” = to get together and “cenar” = to have dinner: “Toda la familia se reúne para cenar”.
